metadata.description: Self-hosted copilot skills for Claude Code: home infrastructure, retro gaming, career, kitchen and training. Lean on tokens, private by construction.

plugins.name: foundation
plugins.description: Setup, health checks and safe publishing: doctor, new-machine bootstrap, and a leak-guarded ship-public flow.

plugins.name: homelab
plugins.description: Keep a Linux home machine healthy: daily health check with notifications (updates, disks, SMART, mounts, services, containers, tailnet) and guided system updates, and an Android TV kept current over adb (Stremio, SmartTube, Tailscale).

plugins.name: career
plugins.description: Unattended weekday job digest: job feeds and boards, recruiter-mail triage, reply and outreach drafts (never sent), job-alert cleanup, one ranked digest in a phone app with push and marks.

plugins.name: retro
plugins.description: Emulation library care: audit, CHD/RVZ conversion, multi-disc playlists, 50 Hz detection, and device sync over adb or to SD cards.

plugins.name: health
plugins.description: Daily health coach: ring/Apple Health data in, a tiny gamified plan out (exercise snacks, seasonal recipe, sleep) to a phone app with push, check-ins, XP and trends.
